_comment: Primus pretrain on ONE pod with multiple GPUs. Set distributed.primus.config_path to your experiment YAML (TorchTitan, Megatron, MaxText, etc.). BACKEND is inferred from the model name when it matches primus_pretrain/<launcher>_<arch>_... (see madengine primus_backend); optional distributed.primus.backend overrides. HF: use docker_env_vars.HF_TOKEN placeholder or runtime secrets. Usage: madengine build ... --additional-context-file examples/k8s-configs/basic/primus-single-node-multi-gpu.json
